svg.title: 2.3 million properties narrowed to about 3,000
svg.desc: A supplier's list of 2.3 million properties moves through four filters: rankings, reviews, destination and price. Each filter lets fewer through. About 3,000 hotels that advisors recognise remain, in gold. The dots are not to scale.
